text: らくに　なったし…　そろそろ　じかんだ！

structure.jp: そろそろ　じかんだ！

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に and なる after a describing word say that something turns into that state. らくに　なった = 'I've come to feel better'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end of a statement means 'and what's more', often giving one reason among others. らくに　なったし = 'I'm feeling better, and besides...'.
